analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md. The patch adds a documentation paragraph at head lines 1129-1141 about Qwen inline MTP assistant chaining. During ordinary decode with multiple rows, target hidden rows are appended to assistant history in step order, and a carry is stored. It also names two rollback env switches, DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CHAINED and DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CARRY. The supplied units are the base excerpt (lines 1622-1777) and the head excerpt (lines 1-415). The changed head range 1129-1141 lies outside both excerpts, so I could not read the new text directly and relied on the patch excerpt. No code, access control, crypto or configuration default changed in the supplied evidence, so there is no observable change to the TB-002, TB-007 or TB-011 controls. The patch describes behavior in libs/mlx-swift-lm EngineLoopV2+MTPOrdinaryHistory.swift, which was not supplied. Remaining questions for a code-bearing pass, if one exists in this PR: (1) whether assistant history and carry state are isolated per request and per cache scope. This bears on A-001 and on the T-041 prefix-cache and cross-tenant channel. (2) Whether carry and history are cleared on cancellation or retirement. This bears on T-028 residual data. (3) Whether the shared GPU memory budget accounts for the extra hidden-row retention. The documentation alone creates no new attack surface.
